user_query: I'm planning a family gathering and I want to create a playlist with tracks that everyone will enjoy. Can you suggest some popular tracks from Soundcloud and provide information about the artists? Also, recommend some comments from listeners to add a personal touch to the playlist.

TaskList.description: Fetch popular tracks from Soundcloud based on current trends and genres suitable for family gatherings.
Retrieve detailed information about each artist associated with the selected tracks to provide context for listeners.
Collect listener comments and reviews about the tracks to enhance the playlist with personal touches.
